task_text: Turn on Sink faucet and put toilet paper in the trash

central_instructions.R1: Use your gripper to turn on the sink faucet.
central_instructions.R2: Pick up the toilet paper and pass it to R3 for disposal.
central_instructions.R3: Receive the toilet paper from R2 and put it in the trash.
central_instructions.R4: Assist R1 if needed, but primarily remain on standby as R1 handles the faucet task.

agent_plans.R1:
[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Use gripper to turn on the sink faucet. (r1_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [ASK_HELP] Request assistance from another robot to dispose of the toilet paper in the trash, as R1 cannot move or pick up heavy objects. (r1_s2)

[5-10 min]

[10-15 min]

[15-20 min]

[20-25 min]

agent_plans.R4:
[0-5 min]

- R4 [LOCAL] Locate the toilet paper and assess if it can be picked up. (r4_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Turn on the sink faucet. (r1_s2)
- R4 [LOCAL] Use gripper to pick up the toilet paper. (r4_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Move the toilet paper to the trash can and drop it in. (r4_s3)

[15-20 min]
